principles.text: Ship fast, then clean. Get it working, then improve the structure.
AI first, but understand the code. I don't merge what I can't explain.
Prefer simple architecture over clever architecture.
Build tools I actually use, not demos.
Make content admin-editable instead of hardcoded when possible.
Local-first when it makes sense; reach for the cloud when it doesn't.
Design matters, but function comes first.
Keep personal projects alive instead of starting new ones.
